Install & set up Notchy
macOS 14 or later
Download Notchy.zip
github.com/Ujjwalkumar-pm/Notchy → Releases
Unzip, then drag to Applications
Double-click Notchy.zip · drag Notchy into Applications
First open only: macOS can't verify Notchy
That's expected: Notchy isn't notarized
System Settings → Open Anyway
Privacy & Security → Security → Open Anyway
Confirm with Touch ID or your password
First run: a quick welcome
Step 1 · Hover the notch
Or press ⌥⌘N from anywhere
Step 2 · Allow what you use
Click Allow… — Notchy opens the right pane
Notchy works without them
Step 3 · Pick your tabs
Optional: a menu bar icon
Your AI coding agent: set up for you
Notchy adds its hooks to the agent's settings
Your old file is backed up first
Turn off in Settings → General
Notchy turns on Start at login
Change it in Settings → General
Open Settings
Right-click the notch → Settings…
…or the menu bar icon
…or open Notchy again from Applications
To uninstall
1 · Settings → General → coding agent integration off
2 · Quit Notchy from the notch menu
3 · Drag Notchy to the Trash
